title: fix(objectql, rest, service-automation): a mapping name two packages hold is refused naming both at /meta, the import door and the connector pull (ADR-0150 D3)
body:
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9Xzw2EuNpUR6HH6h1Gag2sy)_ Part of #32071 Clause-②: no (narrowing) Narrowing: no Metadata-protocol: none Skills-docs: follow-up owed — content/docs/data-modeling/import-mappings.mdx, content/docs/automation/jobs.mdx (neither says what a `mappingName` or a `pull` names when two packages hold it; `skills/**` has no `mappingName` or `pull` mapping text) Claim by `domain:server#3` (6760547602), seat ruling A/A (Claim amendment 6760823385). Reader child for #31700 under epic #31527 (ADR-0150). The card stays open: the pull reading by the job's own package waits on the spec work in #32078. ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么：`mapping` 加进 objectql 的 `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES`；rest 导入门的 `mappingName` 与 service-automation 的 connector pull 都按「无包调用方」走 ADR-0150 D3，并把 `PackageScopedNameRefusedError` 原样答成它自己的 409（不再吞成 404 `MAPPING_NOT_FOUND`）。 - 为什么改：两个包同名 mapping 时，裸 `/meta`、导入、pull 都静默拿注册顺序第一个；导入另一个包的对象会得到 400 `MAPPING_TARGET_MISMATCH`，pull 会把数据写进别的包的对象。 - 风险与回滚：一个持有者的答案逐字节不变（含跨包导入）。四处答案改为 409（见 BREAKING），第一方受影响 0 处。回滚即 revert。 - 先看：`packages/rest/src/import-mapping.ts` 与 `packages/services/service-automation/src/connector-pull.ts` 的 catch，然后 `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-read.ts` 的一行。 - 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/import-integration.test.ts`，预期 46 条全过。 - 需要你做的：无，席位落地。pull 按 job 的包读等 #32078。 ## What changes - **`packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-read.ts`**: `mapping` joins `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES`. So G1's exact qualifier (ADR-0150 D5) and the no-package bare read (D3) now apply to `mapping`. A bare read is the environment's own mapping, else the one package that holds the name, else `PackageScopedNameRefusedError` (`409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, `ambiguous-in-environment`) naming every holder. - **`packages/rest/src/import-mapping.ts`**: the import door's `mappingName` read (`POST /api/v1/data/:object/import` and the async import job) names no package, so it is a caller with no package under D3. Its `catch {}` used to turn every error into `404 MAPPING_NOT_FOUND`. It now answers a `PackageScopedNameRefusedError` with the error's own `status`, `code` and message, which lists every holder. Every other error keeps today's 404. - **`packages/services/service-automation/src/connector-pull.ts`**: the pull's mapping read is the same no-package read. A refusal now fails the pull before any connector call or write, with the error's own code and status and the new refusal reason `mapping_name_refused`, and the message names every holder. Every other error keeps today's `mapping_not_found` 404. - No literal codes or statuses: both readers use the error's own `code`/`status` (one `instanceof` from `@objectstack/core`). - Not touched: `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES`; the `getItem` fallback for compositions without the slice (#32076); the qualified `mappingName` spelling (#32079); the job's package on the pull request contract (#32078). ### BREAKING (four `mapping` answers, first-party count 0) No example app or first-party package declares a mapping name another package declares, and none addresses a mapping at a package that does not hold it. 1. `GET /api/v1/meta/mapping/NAME` for a name two packages hold: FROM `200` with the first registered holder TO `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming both. The fix: `?package=` or `/meta/mapping//NAME`. 2. An import by `mappingName` for such a name: FROM `200` (the request's object was the first holder's target) or `400 MAPPING_TARGET_MISMATCH` (it was the other holder's) TO `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming both, with no row written. The fix: rename one of the two mappings; the import door does not yet take a package (#32079). 3. A connector pull of such a name: FROM pulling through the first holder's mapping into its target TO a refused pull, `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, reason `mapping_name_refused`, naming both, before any call or write. The job run records the failure. The fix: as 2 (#32078 lets the job's package pick its own). 4. `GET /api/v1/meta/mapping/NAME?package=X`, `/meta/mapping/NS/NAME` and `/meta/mapping/_env/NAME`, where X, NS or the environment does not hold the name: FROM `200` with the holder's mapping TO `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming the holder. This is the same exact-qualifier narrowing G1 (#31959, #32001) made for the E8 types. The fix: address the holder the refusal names. The changeset carries the same FROM → TO and `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, since no stored or authored shape changes. ## Why Base readings on main ff04ad81, with `com.qa.bare.alpha` and `com.qa.bare.beta` each holding `qa_shared_mapping` (each targeting its own `*_item`), plus a third package that depends on alpha and holds a mapping into alpha's object: | Door | main | head | |:--|:--|:--| | `GET /meta/mapping/qa_shared_mapping` | 200, alpha's | 409 naming both | | import `qa_shared_mapping` into `alpha_item` | 200 | 409 naming both, no row | | import `qa_shared_mapping` into `beta_item` | 400 `MAPPING_TARGET_MISMATCH` (got alpha's) | 409 naming both, no row | | pull `qa_shared_mapping` | pulls through alpha's | refused 409 naming both | | `/meta/mapping//…`, `?package=` of each holder | 200 | 200, each its own | | one holder, including the cross-package import into alpha's object | 200 | 200, byte-identical | ## Tests - **`packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-e8-readers.test.ts`**: a new describe for `mapping`. Two holders are refused on the protocol's bare read (both faces) and the facade's `get`, naming both. Per-package `get` and the `packageId` exact read each reach their holder. CONTROL: one holder answers what `getItem` answers. The environment's item is served, and zero holders is not-found. - **Forced test change**: the same file pins the read set; the pin now expects the E8 types plus `mapping` (`LATER_TYPES`). - **`packages/rest/src/import-integration.test.ts`**: a new nested describe. Two holders answer `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming both and write nothing. CONTROL: one package holder imports. - **`packages/services/service-automation/src/connector-pull.test.ts`**: a new describe that routes the mapping read through a real `SchemaRegistry` and a real `/meta` protocol. Two holders are refused with the read's own code and 409, reason `mapping_name_refused`, naming both, with no connector call and no write. CONTROL: one holder pulls. - **Dogfood** `packages/qa/dogfood/test/bare-name-one-holder.dogfood.test.ts` (same boot, plus a `zeta` package that depends on alpha and holds a mapping into alpha's object): - Bare `/meta` of the shared name is 409 naming both. - The qualified address and `?package=` each reach their holder. - Importing the shared name into either holder's object is 409 naming both. - A non-holder's qualified read is 409 naming zeta. - CONTROL: showcase's mapping 200 with its `_packageId`; zeta's mapping 200; zeta's import into `alpha_item` 200 with no errors; into `beta_item` still `400 MAPPING_TARGET_MISMATCH`. ## Acceptance notes - The refusal reason name `mapping_name_refused` is new public vocabulary on the pull's refusal union; it is the seat's to confirm. - FROM → TO 4 (a non-holder qualified read) was not on the ruling's list. It falls out of `mapping` joining the read set, the same way G1 did for the E8 types, and it is measured, pinned and declared. - Relay `pr_create` opens this PR as a draft and drops assignees. ## Verification Head 2dab26ba, branched from main ff04ad81. Every heavy run went under `os-verify-lock`. - `@objectstack/objectql`: 583 files, 12025 passed. `@objectstack/rest`: 399 files, 7660 passed (332 skipped). `@objectstack/service-automation`: 270 files, 3563 passed. Typechecks of objectql, rest, service-automation and dogfood exit 0. eslint (`--no-inline-config`) on the changed files exits 0. - Dogfood, the full battery: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` at head, 449 files (445 passed, 3 skipped, 1 failed), 3742 tests (3699 passed, 42 skipped, 1 failed), lock VERDICT exit 1 (41m17s). The one failure is a 5000ms timeout in `package-commit-revert-path-package.dogfood.test.ts` ("[#29414] control: a writable package's edit commit restores its own row in place"), which publishes objects and reads no mapping. Rerun alone under the lock it passes 12/12 (VERDICT exit 0). The mapping file `bare-name-one-holder.dogfood.test.ts` is not among the failures, and run alone it passes 9/9. - Gates: `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 74 families on 2dab26ba. All 74 ran with exit 0, and `--ran` reports 74 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first exited 3 (no `dist/` for some packages) and was rerun green once the dogfood build had built them. - CONTROL byte-identity: the one-holder lines of the base probe and the head probe (11 lines, first 300 bytes of each body, record ids stripped) are identical.
Ablations (each restored, git diff HEAD empty, dist rebuilt before dogfood, preflight checked) All used `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`; dogfood legs used `scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs`. 1. Remove `mapping` from `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES`: objectql 2 red (the read-set pin, the two-holder refusal), rest 1 red, service-automation 1 red, dogfood 2 red (bare `/meta`, import). The FROM side of FROM → TO 4 (200 with the holder's mapping) was read under this ablation. 2. The import door swallows the refusal again (`catch {}`): rest 1 red; dogfood's import pin red with `404 MAPPING_NOT_FOUND`. 3. The pull swallows the refusal again: service-automation 1 red (`mapping_not_found` instead of `mapping_name_refused`).
